name: pilot_jee_slice_v1
note: Synthetic slice written by hand to regression-test the deterministic rule table and the metric arithmetic in evaluation/curriculum_eval.py. It is NOT expert-reviewed and makes no accuracy claim beyond the hand-enumerated counts in expected_counts. Items p5 and h3 are deliberate failure cases: p5 covers two concepts while the reference tags only one (a single-label mapper must be wrong about one of them), and h3 is an extraction/coverage gap where the expected term never reaches the mapper. The same file doubles as the seed spec: tests load 'concepts'/'relationships' into CurriculumSpec and pass the whole object to evaluate_curriculum as the reference. Prerequisite edges appear both in each concept's 'prerequisites' list and in 'relationships' so that 'relationships' is the complete gold edge list; CurriculumGraphValidator reports any disagreement between the two as PREREQUISITE_DIRECTION_MISMATCH or PREREQUISITE_LIST_UNBACKED, and seed_curriculum de-duplicates the edges it creates from them.
title: Pilot JEE slice (physics, chemistry, mathematics)

concepts.name: Units and Measurement
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Physical quantities are compared through agreed units; the SI system fixes a set of base units so measurements are reproducible.

concepts.name: Distance
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Total length of the path actually travelled, a scalar with no direction.

concepts.name: Displacement
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Change in position of a body, a vector pointing from the initial to the final position.

concepts.name: Position-Time Graph
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Plot of position against time; its slope at a point is the instantaneous velocity.

concepts.name: Velocity-Time Graph
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Plot of velocity against time; its slope is acceleration and the area under it is displacement.

concepts.name: Mole Concept
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The mole ties a measurable mass to a countable number of particles through the Avogadro constant.

concepts.name: Equilibrium
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The state in which forward and reverse processes proceed at equal rates so net amounts stop changing.

concepts.name: Chemical Equilibrium
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Equilibrium as it applies to a reversible reaction, described by the equilibrium constant.

concepts.name: Logarithm
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The logarithm is the inverse of exponentiation: log_b(x) is the power to which b must be raised to give x.

concepts.name: Logarithmic Function
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The function x -> log_b(x), its domain, range, graph and derivatives.

relationships.rationale: Units are needed before any measurement of length.
Units are needed before any measurement of length.
A position axis is built from displacement.
Velocity is read off the slope of a position-time graph.
Amounts of substance are needed to express equilibrium compositions.
The general idea of equilibrium precedes its chemical application.
The logarithm must be defined before it can be studied as a function.
Chemical equilibrium is one case of equilibrium generally.

items.text: SI units are the standard units used across the physical sciences.
Displacement is the change in position of an object measured along the shortest path.
A Velocity-Time Graph shows how the velocity of a particle varies with time, and its slope gives acceleration.
Chemical equilibrium is dynamic and the rates of the forward and reverse reactions are equal.
The total path length covered by a body is its distance, which is a scalar quantity, unlike the change in position.
The school closed early for the festival holiday and the students went home.
The number of moles in 18 g of water is one, since the molar mass of water is 18 g/mol.
The logarithm of a product equals the sum of the logarithms of its factors.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in green plants.
